raw_text: A deepfake video of a sitting Supreme Court judge purporting to show the announcement of a verdict on a sensitive religious land dispute was debunked today after the Court issued an emergency clarification. Forensic analysis by IIT Delhi's deepfake detection lab confirmed the video used face-swap and voice cloning technology. The incident has been referred to the Cyber Crime Cell. Legal experts called it an unprecedented attack on judicial integrity.
clean_text: LiveLaw reports deepfake of Supreme Court judge debunked. Court issued emergency clarification. IIT Delhi confirmed face-swap and voice cloning. Referred to Cyber Crime Cell.
